environment_setting: A small coastal town in Country B, where fishing and maritime activities are common, and disputes often arise among fishermen over fishing zones.
norm_base: Citizens Assault by striking, beating or wounding within maritime jurisdiction Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year

character_profile.name: John Fisher
character_profile.goal: secure the best fishing spot for a big catch

legitimate.legitimate_action: Negotiating peacefully with other fishermen to secure a fishing spot
legitimate.benefits: Maintains good relationships with other fishermen, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: May lose the desired fishing spot to others, potentially smaller catch

illegal.illegal_action: Physically assaulting another fisherman to claim the fishing spot
illegal.benefits: Secures the desired fishing spot, potentially larger catch
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year if caught, damaged reputation

character_profile.name: Mike Shore
character_profile.goal: maintain peace and order in maritime jurisdiction

legitimate.legitimate_action: Intervening to stop John Fisher from assaulting another fisherman
legitimate.benefits: Prevents escalation of violence, upholds the law
legitimate.costs: Risk of personal injury during intervention, time spent resolving the conflict

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring the incident and not intervening
illegal.benefits: Avoids personal risk and effort, saves time
illegal.costs: If discovered, disciplinary action or job loss

character_profile.name: Sarah Tide
character_profile.goal: avoid conflicts and focus on fishing

legitimate.legitimate_action: Attempting to mediate the conflict between John Fisher and the other fisherman
legitimate.benefits: Helps maintain peace, avoids escalation of violence
legitimate.costs: May face backlash from John Fisher or others involved, wastes time

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John Fisher to assault the other fisherman to secure the spot
illegal.benefits: Potentially secures a better fishing spot for herself by aligning with John Fisher
illegal.costs: If discovered, fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year as an accomplice
